_comment: Observed Fred tenant-response key sets, captured from the live devnet (ENG-638).
This is the ONLY artifact in the repo derived from what Fred actually sends rather
than from reading its Go by hand. Unit fixtures and mono's TypeScript interfaces are
two hand-mirrors that can agree with each other while both being wrong about the
provider -- which is exactly how Fred's ENG-508 removal of `last_error` stayed
invisible to a green CI. Only an observation can notice that.
WHAT IS ACTUALLY OBSERVABLE. e2e drives the MCP tools, not the provider HTTP API
(the test client speaks stdio MCP and holds no wallet, so it cannot mint an ADR-036
token for a raw fetch). Two of the three surfaces still expose Fred's own keys:
app_status.fredStatus and app_releases.releases[] are zod looseObjects fed from the
raw provider response, so unmodelled Fred keys pass through and ARE visible here.
app_diagnostics is an explicit projection, so its key set is mono's contract rather
than Fred's -- recorded as such below, and it cannot detect a field Fred adds.
`always`: keys expected on every successful call for the lease state the e2e flow
exercises (a healthy ACTIVE lease). A missing one FAILS -- that is the ENG-508 class
of break, where mono reads a field the provider stopped sending.
`sometimes`: legitimately conditional keys. Failure attribution appears only once a
failure has been recorded; retention keys only on a retained lease. Absence is not a
signal. But a key in NEITHER list is, because it means Fred grew a field mono does
not model.
`mono_strips`: keys Fred sends that mono deliberately removes before the model sees
them, so their absence here is correct and must not be read as provider drift.
`mono_adds`: the mirror image -- keys mono DERIVES that Fred never sends, so their
presence is also not provider drift. Without this they would read as an unmodelled
Fred field, which is the opposite of the truth.
When this fails, do not edit this file to make it pass. Work out which side moved:
if Fred dropped a key mono reads, that is a client fix; if Fred added one, decide
whether to model it, then record it here.
fred_ref_note: submodules/fred pin at capture time; e2e builds the devnet from this source
